description:
In this new “Strange Phenomenon Rescue” genre, uncover the secrets behind inexplicable events and a mysterious object. 
Enter “Platform 5 Dungeons,” a massive terminal called Chijuku Station under evacuation orders. 
As part of the rescue team, you must find and gain the trust of the uncle left behind, while time loops repeatedly. 
Pick up trash as weapons to fend off lurking anomalies. 
Enjoy a thrilling 1–2 hour rescue drama as you unravel the station’s hidden mysteries.
name: Platform5 Dungeons
intro:
Escape a mysterious station and save the stranded uncle!
Experience the first story-driven horror adventure in the popular ‘Platform’ series!
